description:
The same status check as verify_business for 1 to 100 businesses (Illinois and Florida) in one call. Use it for lead lists. A bad item returns an error object in its own slot and is not counted; a batch with no valid item is refused and costs nothing.
Inputs: businesses, an array of {name, optional state (recommended), optional city, optional zip}, same limits as verify_business.
Price: $1.00 flat per call with x402. Under 50 names, single verify_business calls are cheaper. A monthly API key also works: one unit per valid business. Call coverage first (free).
Verdicts:
- active: Registered and in good standing, or still active with a status flag listed in flags.
- inactive: The state record shows the entity dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, merged or otherwise no longer active.
- possible_match: A record with a similar, not identical, name exists. Its status is in match.record_verdict. Confirm with the business's ZIP code, or by comparing the returned name, before relying on it. A similar-name match to a corporation always stays possible_match, because the state publishes no address for corporations.
- not_found: No matching record in the covered Illinois data. not_found does not mean the business is fake.
- unknown: A record exists but the data cannot say whether it still operates (Will County DBA filings, or an unrecognised status).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
possible_match is confirmed only by a matching ZIP, never by city alone. not_found does not mean the business is fake: insurers, banks and other entities chartered outside the Secretary of State, and sole proprietors and general partnerships outside Will County, are not covered. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"businesses":[{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","state":"IL","zip":"60435"},{"name":"Sample Hardware Co","state":"IL"}]}
Example response: {"results":[{"verdict":"active","match":{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","county_source":"office","source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"..."}},{"verdict":"not_found","match":null}]}

businesses.description: 1 to 100 objects of {name, state?, city?, zip?}, the same fields as verify_business.
